upper_lake_bhojtal.name: Upper Lake (Bhojtal / Bada Talab)
upper_lake_bhojtal.description: Asia's largest artificial lake built by Paramara King Raja Bhoj in the 11th century; a designated Ramsar wetland famous for scenic boat rides, water sports, and stunning sunsets.

van_vihar_national_park.name: Van Vihar National Park
van_vihar_national_park.description: Unique open-concept national park and zoological haven nestled along the southern shore of Bhojtal, where visitors can cycle through natural habitats housing tigers, leopards, and bears.
van_vihar_national_park.best_time_to_visit: Early morning or late afternoon for wildlife sightings

taj_ul_masajid.name: Taj-ul-Masajid
taj_ul_masajid.description: Known as the 'Crown of Mosques', one of the largest mosques in Asia, featuring a grand pink sandstone facade, three colossal marble domes, and soaring 18-storey minarets.

bharat_bhavan.name: Bharat Bhavan
bharat_bhavan.description: World-renowned multi-arts center designed by architect Charles Correa overlooking Upper Lake, housing contemporary art galleries, a tribal art museum, poetry library, and open-air amphitheatres.
bharat_bhavan.best_time_to_visit: Late afternoon during exhibitions or cultural performances

tribal_museum_bhopal.name: Madhya Pradesh Tribal Museum
tribal_museum_bhopal.description: Acclaimed immersive museum on Shyamala Hills bringing alive the architecture, spiritual cosmos, wedding traditions, and art forms of MP's major indigenous tribes (Gond, Bhil, Baiga, Korku).

igrms_manav_sangrahalaya.name: Indira Gandhi Rashtriya Manav Sangrahalaya (IGRMS)
igrms_manav_sangrahalaya.description: Sprawling 200-acre anthropological museum presenting the evolution of humankind with life-size traditional dwellings built by master tribal craftsmen from across all Indian states.

state_museum_bhopal.name: State Museum Bhopal
state_museum_bhopal.description: State-of-the-art museum housing 17 themed galleries, including priceless Paramara stone sculptures, royal royal weaponry, miniature paintings, and historical coins.

bhojpur_temple.name: Bhojeshwar Shiva Temple, Bhojpur
bhojpur_temple.description: Known as the 'Somnath of the East', an 11th-century monumental temple dedicated to Shiva, housing a 7.5-foot monolithic Shivalinga carved out of a single rock.
bhojpur_temple.best_time_to_visit: Morning or sunset on the Betwa riverbank

sanchi_stupa.name: Great Stupa at Sanchi
sanchi_stupa.description: UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of India's oldest stone structures, commissioned by Emperor Ashoka in the 3rd century BCE, famed for elaborately carved torana gateways.

bhimbetka_rock_shelters.name: Bhimbetka Rock Shelters
bhimbetka_rock_shelters.description: UNESCO World Heritage Site showcasing over 750 rock shelters with prehistoric cave paintings dating back over 30,000 years, chronicling human life from the Paleolithic to medieval eras.

birla_mandir_lakshmi_narayan.name: Lakshmi Narayan Temple (Birla Mandir)
birla_mandir_lakshmi_narayan.description: Grand yellow sandstone temple crowning Arera Hills dedicated to Lord Vishnu and Goddess Lakshmi, offering sweeping panoramic vistas across the twin lakes and city skyline.
birla_mandir_lakshmi_narayan.best_time_to_visit: Sunset hour for city panorama and evening aarti

gohar_mahal.name: Gohar Mahal
gohar_mahal.description: Historic 1820 lakefront mansion built by Qudsia Begum (first female ruler of Bhopal), fusing Mughal and Rajput styles, often hosting lively handloom and handicraft expos.
gohar_mahal.best_time_to_visit: Late afternoon alongside Upper Lake promenade

shaukat_mahal_sadar_manzil.name: Shaukat Mahal & Sadar Manzil
shaukat_mahal_sadar_manzil.description: Unique architectural anomaly in the heart of Old Bhopal designed by a French Bourbon descendant, blending Gothic spires, Renaissance arches, and post-Renaissance motifs.

moti_masjid_bhopal.name: Moti Masjid (Pearl Mosque), Bhopal
moti_masjid_bhopal.description: Elegantly scaled 1860 mosque built by Sikandar Jehan Begum in red sandstone with a glistening white marble facade, featuring twin dark red minarets crowned with gold spires.

manuabhan_tekri.name: Manuabhan Tekri (Mahaveer Giri)
manuabhan_tekri.description: Perched on a high hillock accessible by ropeway or road, this prominent Jain temple shrine preserves footwear relics of Jain saints and affords the most expansive aerial view of Bhopal.
manuabhan_tekri.best_time_to_visit: Evening for the ropeway ride and sunset panorama

sair_sapata.name: Sair Sapata Tourism & Entertainment Complex
sair_sapata.description: Vibrant leisure tourism complex on the banks of Bhadbhada, featuring an iconic pedestrian suspension bridge, children's toy train, musical fountain, and water zorbing.
sair_sapata.best_time_to_visit: Evening for illuminated bridge and fountains

lower_lake_chhota_talab.name: Lower Lake (Chhota Talab)
lower_lake_chhota_talab.description: Constructed in 1794 by Chhote Khan to beautify the city, forming together with Bhojtal the celebrated twin lakes of Bhopal separated by the historic Kamla Park bridge.

rani_kamlapati_palace.name: Rani Kamlapati Palace
rani_kamlapati_palace.description: 18th-century residence of brave Gond Queen Rani Kamlapati, set on the defensive causeway between the Upper and Lower lakes within scenic Kamla Park.

kerwa_dam.name: Kerwa Dam & Ecotourism Area
kerwa_dam.description: Picturesque eco-tourism retreat surrounded by forested hills on Bhopal's outskirts, renowned for South Asia's longest twin-zipline, trekking, and tranquil reservoir views.

kaliasot_dam.name: Kaliasot Dam
kaliasot_dam.description: Scenic storage reservoir near Chunabhatti popular for sunset watching, birdwatching, and roaring floodgate spectacles during heavy monsoon downpours.
kaliasot_dam.best_time_to_visit: Sunset or during monsoon gate openings

regional_science_centre_bhopal.name: Regional Science Centre, Bhopal
regional_science_centre_bhopal.description: Dynamic science museum and interactive educational hub on Shyamala Hills featuring a digital planetarium, 3D science theater, and open-air science park.
regional_science_centre_bhopal.best_time_to_visit: Morning or early afternoon for planetarium shows

islamnagar_fort.name: Islamnagar Fort (Chaman Mahal & Rani Mahal)
islamnagar_fort.description: Historic 18th-century citadel established by Dost Mohammad Khan as Bhopal State's first capital, celebrated for the palatial Chaman Mahal and Charbagh gardens.

raisen_fort.name: Raisen Fort
raisen_fort.description: Monumental 13th-century hilltop fortress boasting nine gateways, massive ramparts, ancient rock-cut reservoirs, temples, and a medieval mosque overlooking the Malwa plains.
raisen_fort.best_time_to_visit: Early morning for hike and views

db_city_mall_bhopal.name: DB City Mall, Bhopal
db_city_mall_bhopal.description: Central India's largest premier retail and entertainment destination in MP Nagar, featuring over 180 global brands, multiplex cinema, and expansive dining concourses.

new_market_bhopal.name: New Market (TT Nagar)
new_market_bhopal.description: The commercial heart of modern Bhopal in TT Nagar, renowned for handwoven Chanderi and Maheshwari sarees, Bhopali batua bags, clothing boutiques, and street food.

chowk_bazaar_bhopal.name: Chowk Bazaar (Old City Bhopal)
chowk_bazaar_bhopal.description: Vibrant heritage market in the walled city steeped in royal Nawabi charm, famed for traditional Ittar (perfumes), intricate Zari-Zardozi embroideries, silverware, and brassware.
chowk_bazaar_bhopal.best_time_to_visit: Evening to soak in the lively old-city buzz

chatori_gali_bhopal.name: Chatori Gali (Food Street of Bhopal)
chatori_gali_bhopal.description: Bhopal's most legendary culinary lane located near Chowk, celebrated for melt-in-mouth Bhopali seekh kebabs, haleem, biryani, bun muska, and rich Sulaimani tea.
chatori_gali_bhopal.best_time_to_visit: Night (after 8:00 PM) for authentic street food feasts

mp_tourism_boat_club.name: MP Tourism Boat Club (Upper Lake)
mp_tourism_boat_club.description: The epicenter of water tourism on Bhojtal offering speedboats, paddleboats, sunset cruise liners, and a waterfront promenade lined with open-air cafes.
mp_tourism_boat_club.best_time_to_visit: Late afternoon for the sunset cruise

sheetaldas_ki_bagiya.name: Sheetaldas Ki Bagiya (VIP Road Promenade)
sheetaldas_ki_bagiya.description: Picturesque tiered garden promenade along VIP Road right opposite the towering statue of Raja Bhoj in Upper Lake, renowned as Bhopal's top sunset photography spot.

raja_bhoj_statue.name: Statue of Raja Bhoj, VIP Road
raja_bhoj_statue.description: Colossal 32-foot bronze statue of legendary scholar-king Raja Bhoj installed on a lake bastion in Upper Lake, standing as the defining monumental emblem of Bhopal.
raja_bhoj_statue.best_time_to_visit: Evening when illuminated against the dark waters

shahpura_lake_promenade.name: Shahpura Lake Promenade
shahpura_lake_promenade.description: Serene urban lake surrounded by manicured walking tracks, lush lawns, open gymnasiums, and sunset seating benches in south-central Bhopal.
shahpura_lake_promenade.best_time_to_visit: Morning walk or relaxed evening sunset

ekant_park.name: Ekant Park
ekant_park.description: Densely wooded 25-hectare urban biodiversity forest in Char Imli offering scenic earthen tracks, bamboo groves, and rich avian bird life.
ekant_park.best_time_to_visit: Early morning for nature walks and birding

chinar_park.name: Chinar Park
chinar_park.description: Centrally located public park adorned with stone sculptures, blooming flower beds, fountains, and illuminated walking paths near MP Nagar.

gufa_mandir_lalghati.name: Gufa Mandir (Lalghati Cave Temple)
gufa_mandir_lalghati.description: Natural rock cave temple sanctuary founded in 1965 by Swami Narayandas Ji, dedicated to Lord Shiva, Goddess Durga, and Lord Hanuman amidst quiet hills.

halali_dam.name: Halali Dam & Reservoir
halali_dam.description: Expansive water reservoir on the Halali River built across a 40-km stretch, featuring an MP Tourism resort, boating facilities, and scenic hill vistas.

regional_museum_of_natural_history_bhopa.name: Regional Museum of Natural History (RMNH)
regional_museum_of_natural_history_bhopa.description: Fascinating natural science museum near Shahpura Lake featuring life-size prehistoric dinosaur models, fossil exhibits, wildlife dioramas, and a sensory garden.

golghar_museum.name: Golghar Museum (The Round House)
golghar_museum.description: Unique circular 19th-century royal office built by Nawab Shah Jahan Begum, featuring 12 arched gateways and a high-domed rotunda preserving royal correspondence and artifacts.

khatlapura_temple.name: Khatlapura Temple & Ghat
khatlapura_temple.description: Centuries-old riverside temple dedicated to Lord Rama perched on the eastern ghats of Lower Lake, celebrated for its spiritual riverfront steps and aartis.

taj_mahal_palace_bhopal.name: Taj Mahal Palace, Bhopal
taj_mahal_palace_bhopal.description: One of the largest royal palaces ever built in British India, constructed over 13 years by Sultan Shah Jahan Begum, housing 120 rooms, royal courtyards, and Sheesh Mahal.

kamla_park.name: Kamla Park
kamla_park.description: Historic public garden bridge laid out between the Upper and Lower lakes, commanding twin waterfront panoramas and housing Rani Kamlapati's historic palace.

aashima_mall.name: Aashima Anupama Mall
aashima_mall.description: Major shopping and lifestyle hub located on Hoshangabad Road featuring Cinepolis multiplex, high-street brand outlets, and indoor games zone.

crescent_water_park_sehore.name: Crescent Water & Amusement Park
crescent_water_park_sehore.description: Sprawling water theme park featuring wave pools, looping tube slides, rain dance arenas, and thrill rides on the Bhopal-Indore highway.

kali_mandir_talaiya.name: Maa Kali Mandir, Talaiya
kali_mandir_talaiya.description: Historic and deeply venerated temple dedicated to Goddess Kali on the banks of Lower Lake, celebrated for grand Navratri celebrations and divine rituals.

samasgarh_temple.name: Samasgarh Ancient Temple Ruins
samasgarh_temple.description: Hidden 10th-century archaeological temple complex tucked inside a dense teak forest, showcasing hundreds of carved Paramara sculptures of Shiva and Jain Tirthankaras.

hathikheda_dam.name: Hathikheda Dam
hathikheda_dam.description: Serene and lesser-known reservoir on the eastern periphery of Bhopal, offering quiet natural surroundings away from city crowds.

yaadgar_e_shahjahani_park.name: Yaadgar-e-Shahjahani Park
yaadgar_e_shahjahani_park.description: Sprawling historical garden located adjacent to Taj-ul-Masajid, laid out during Nawab Shah Jahan Begum's reign with walking circuits and green lawns.

mayur_park.name: Mayur Park (Peacock Park)
mayur_park.description: Charming tree-shaded municipal park known for frequent sightings of dancing wild peacocks, rose beds, and paved stroll paths.

archaeological_museum_bhopal.name: Archaeological Museum, Banganga
archaeological_museum_bhopal.description: Historic museum displaying magnificent ancient stone statues of Hindu deities, Jain Tirthankaras, and Buddhist relics recovered from Madhya Pradesh archaeological sites.

kaliyasot_adventure_camp.name: Kaliyasot Adventure & Nature Camp
kaliyasot_adventure_camp.description: Outdoor recreation center nestled in the rugged hillocks around Kaliyasot reservoir, offering rock climbing, rappelling, kayaking, and camping setups.

vardhaman_park.name: Vardhaman Park
vardhaman_park.description: Lush hillside garden at the starting end of VIP Road, showcasing terraced flower beds, rose gardens, and calming vistas of the Bhojtal waters.
